ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions across both lobes. A focal low-intensity black triangular blob is centered at the peduncle/median notch intersection. Black marginal banding is mapped along the trailing edge. Two discrete, vertical high-contrast black marks are located on the medial-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 78 degrees; vertex is sharply defined at the central fluke intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration across the boundary; peaks and valleys are most pronounced at the distal tips where pixel texture is highly fragmented.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lateral outer margins exhibit a convex sweep; trailing edges follow a generally linear trajectory with a slight concave transition into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured clusters of brownish-grey pixels (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel vertical black linear markings on the right lobe; several faint, horizontally-oriented grey linear disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological colonization (barnacles) at both distal fluke tips; irregular pigmentation mottling and fringe wear along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'twin-dash' vertical pigmentation marking located in the mid-region of the right lobe.
